name: Tirzah
line: Tirzah was an old Canaanite city that later became a royal home for the kings of northern Israel, where kings reigned, fell, and died.

moments.title: A king of Tirzah is listed
moments.text: The king of Tirzah is named as one of the kings in a list. The verse says there were thirty-one kings in all.

moments.title: Jeroboam's son dies
moments.text: Jeroboam's wife went to Tirzah. As soon as she stepped over the threshold of the house, the boy died.

moments.title: Baasha reigns in Tirzah
moments.text: Baasha became king of all Israel in the third year of Asa's reign over Judah. He reigned in Tirzah twenty-four years.

moments.title: Zimri kills Elah
moments.text: King Elah was in Tirzah getting drunk when his servant Zimri plotted against him. Zimri killed him and reigned in his place.

moments.title: Omri surrounds Tirzah
moments.text: Omri and the Israelites marched up and surrounded Tirzah. When Zimri saw the city was captured, he burned the royal palace down upon himself.
